meaning_of_dot: Reincarnate the frozen P4 preparation and execute the P4 Capture integration graph continuously through every automatable dependency/gate. The dot is not a request to plan again, not permission to improvise architecture, and not a one-item step signal.
mandatory_start_sequence: Read this contract and every P4 preparation path listed above.
Validate that the title index contains exactly 100 planned items and the execution plan expands the same 001-100 coverage.
Run Prometeo Reincarnation from repository bootstrap sources; do not use chat history as authority.
Validate Current Graph, Catalog, Lineage, Capability Registry, PENDING/CARRY/HOT/WATERMARKS and receipt ledger.
Validate Part 3 final receipt and V53/V23 inherited identities.
Rerun the post-Part-3 comparison because P4-00 coordination commits have intentionally advanced main.
Inspect actual gh-pages Served participation and re-establish the v2/v3 publication-race evidence.
Create the P4 Seed and Work Item from the frozen P4 objective.
Append a legitimate standard P4 workstream/preparation receipt after validating the existing ledger, before material product work.
Only then enter P4-02 and subsequent material gates.
execution_rules: Use coordination/P4_CAPTURE_TITLE_INDEX.json and P4_CAPTURE_EXECUTION_PLAN.md as the complete preplanned build map; do not discard later gates after solving an early symptom.
Classify every numbered P4 item ACTIVE, N/A or DEFER during execution; N/A/DEFER require evidence/reason.
Execute all remaining automatable gates in dependency order in the same turn/session whenever tools permit.
Do not stop between technical subgates merely to request another dot or provide a recap.
Repair worker-soluble technical failures and rerun affected gates in the same execution turn.
Do not manufacture tests, experiments, receipts, Human acceptance, mobile observations or Served evidence.
Do not interpret a successful source write, workflow run or published asset as Served verification.
Do not treat latest, Current, Candidate, Human Accepted and Served as synonyms.
Do not treat stored Capture, raw transcript, summary or Patent as product authority.
Do not silently export LOCAL Capture material; real Patent export requires the scoped Human export/declassification action defined by P4-10.
Do not expose workspace/service-role secrets in browser code, GitHub, Patent payloads, receipts or logs.
Do not make Supabase a competing Current/receipt authority; it remains private Capture transport/status cache.
Do not redesign or overwrite exact V53 accepted visible bytes as an implementation shortcut.
Use Input Ownership/Focus Lease and the V53 no-extra-visible-shell adapter rather than adding an uncontrolled second Navigator chrome.
Preserve raw local audio on transcription failure and preserve exact Capture revision history through edits/Patent snapshots.
Prefer Whisper Small multilingual Spanish quality; if device limits require fallback, make the tier change explicit and try multilingual Base before any Tiny downgrade.
Resolve page-local vs shared capability ownership and WHERE_USED before modifying code.
Declare exact write scope, tests, rollback and publication owner before first material write.
Return Candidate until exact Human acceptance exists where acceptance is required.
Promotion after acceptance must be receipt-backed pointer movement followed by independent Served verification and rollback proof as required.
When a Work Item is accepted/integrated, compact Capture memory only under the exact-ten/rolling-summary/watermark contract and preserve reopenable provenance.

expected_human_boundaries.condition: A required real Android/physical microphone or transcription-quality observation cannot be automated with available tools.
expected_human_boundaries.behavior: Complete all other worker-soluble gates first, then provide the exact candidate/test script and smallest device action needed. Do not fabricate the device result.

expected_human_boundaries.condition: The final Capture integration candidate changes visible/behavioral Human Accepted scope and requires Human acceptance.
expected_human_boundaries.behavior: Present the exact canary and concise review script. Stop only at this authority boundary; after explicit acceptance, continue P4-19-D through P4-20 when tools permit.

expected_human_boundaries.condition: A real user Capture is to be exported into a Patent.
expected_human_boundaries.behavior: Require the explicit selected-scope Prepare Patent action/export receipt. Synthetic fixtures may test the protocol without exporting real LOCAL content.

stop_conditions: P4 closes with a valid final receipt/evidence chain and truthful final state.
A genuine Human authority boundary is reached after all preceding automatable work is complete.
A required external/private source or write permission remains unavailable after an actual attempt and cannot be repaired in the current turn.
A physical-device empirical gate is necessary and no device automation is available.
on_stop: Persist the exact completed gate and restart gate in state/DOT_STATE.json and state/PENDING.json.
Record what remains unchanged and the exact blocker/evidence.
Never mark P4 COMPLETE unless the final evidence chain supports it.
target: Integrate Capture as the durable human-intent intake for Prometeo: multi-page consecutive voice capture → local-first Spanish transcription → private sync → Context Foundry → Seed/Work Item → Patent v2 → fresh-agent Reincarnation and exhaustive planning → safe Candidate/release/receipt → feedback and memory metabolism, while preserving V53 authority, privacy, lineage and release truth.
